text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, manage your time by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting mini-deadlines for each one. Next, prioritise your work: focus on the most important tasks first and avoid wasting time on things that can wait. It is also wise to manage the scope of a project, which means agreeing clearly on what is included and what is not, so you don't take on too much. Finally, communicate openly with your team or manager. If a problem appears, speak up early instead of hiding it. Good communication helps everyone stay calm and find solutions together.
